acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The capability schema allows a fact (e.g. HA identity) to be shared across multiple capabilities without duplicating its extraction; a worked example is given.
AC-2: The closed step-kind set is enumerated exhaustively and the document states that adding a kind is an amendment.
AC-3: The gate-registry resolution rule is a concrete, testable algorithm; the UNKNOWN case is shown blocking device execution while leaving the offline spec/parser buildable.
AC-4: The VSX/ClusterXL multiplicity model is demonstrated against a worked ClusterXL example and a worked VSX example, each preserving distinct member/context identity.
AC-5: The transport decision names the exact evidence bar (what a Line-1 capture must show) before a capability may default to interactive SSH instead of exec-per-step.
AC-6: KNOWN/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE are modeled as first-class states in the registry schema, not booleans.
AC-7: C2's step interface (kind, gate reference, timeout, expect/validation result) is shown populated from this registry with a concrete worked example.
AC-8: §7 gives at least ten testable acceptance criteria for B1-4/B1-5/B1-6.
AC-9: §8 lists every contradiction with frozen authority found (or states none and which documents were checked); no PO-reserved decision is reopened.

AC-10: The document does not perform capability extraction or define the extraction inventory (C6's scope) -- it defines only the schema a completed extraction spec populates, and states this boundary explicitly.

invariants: A capability is a semantic unit, not a Line-1 file (workflow section 3.3, Astra 4.1): the registry's schema must allow one capability to be composed from facts originally read from multiple Line-1 sources (e.g. HA identity shared by inventory, readiness and backup) -- do not model capabilities as a 1:1 mirror of Line-1 file boundaries

Closed step kinds only (design section 6.3): enumerate the exact set (e.g. exec-command, expect-match, fetch-file, xml-api-call) and state that this set is closed -- adding a kind is itself an amendment, not a runtime configuration choice

Every step names its gate-registry entry; the gate-registry resolution rule (K-4) specifies exactly how a step's command/call tuple resolves to one network-device command gate row (AGENTS.md), and what happens when no row exists (workflow section 3.1 field 3: recorded UNKNOWN, blocks device execution, does not block the offline spec/parser)

VSX/ClusterXL multiplicity rules (CP-D6): a capability against a ClusterXL cluster or a VSX virtual-system context must specify how member/context multiplicity is represented in the capability's target model without collapsing distinct members/contexts into one identity

Transport decision (CP-D7): validated-device-first -- a capability defaults to the least-interactive transport proven sufficient by its Line-1 evidence (SSH exec-per-step, PAN XML API, SFTP/SCP); interactive/expect-style SSH is used only where the extraction spec's Line-1 provenance proves it necessary, and the contract states the evidence bar for that proof
Field states from workflow section 3.1 (KNOWN/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE) are first-class in the registry schema, not flattened to booleans or omitted fields
No decision frozen in UI2_0_BASELINE_CONTRACT.md is reopened; contradictions with frozen authority are REPORTED in a dedicated section, never silently resolved

DELIVERED: docs/design/UI2_0_C4_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_GATE_RESOLUTION_CONTRACT.md (DRAFT -- FOR PRODUCT OWNER FREEZE). PR #166 MERGED (merge commit ab4c6a13b14a61faf94012b3c15952a120055c77).

Self-check against AC-1..AC-10:
AC-1 (shared fact, no duplicate extraction): SATISFIED -- §2.5 defines produces_facts/consumes_facts and works ha_state shared across cp_gaia_inventory_show_version_ha_state, cp_gaia_ha_readiness and cp_gaia_backup_local via a provenance_id reference, not re-derivation.
AC-2 (closed step-kind set, exhaustive, amendment law stated): SATISFIED -- §2.3 enumerates 8 kinds (connect/exec/poll/sftp_get/scp_get/sftp_put/xml_api_call/verify/disconnect), states the set is closed and that adding a kind is a C4-successor amendment.
AC-3 (concrete testable gate-resolution algorithm; UNKNOWN blocks execution not spec): SATISFIED -- §3.3's 7-step deterministic algorithm (exact-match canonical-command-key, zero/one/many-row cases, sign-off-state gating); §3.5's execution-eligible-view mechanism realizes the UNKNOWN-blocks-device-execution-not-offline-build rule without adding a new C2 pre-execution check.
AC-4 (VSX/ClusterXL worked examples, distinct identity preserved): SATISFIED -- §4.3 (fw-ist-core, two independent physical members, MEMBER_SPECIFIC facts) and §4.4 (vsx-ist-01, VS0/VS2/VS5 as three distinct provenance chains over one physical device_id); §4.2's composite target_ref never creates a VS-scoped or cluster-scoped devices/endpoints row (CP-D6).
AC-5 (transport decision names the exact evidence bar): SATISFIED -- §5.2: a capability may declare ssh_interactive only when its C6 spec's Line-1 source pointers include a captured cross-command shell-state dependency (worked against vsx_runner.py's vsenv <VSID> pattern); session reuse alone is explicitly named as insufficient evidence.
AC-6 (KNOWN/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE first-class, not booleans): SATISFIED -- §2.6 fixes every state-carrying field as a three-valued enum with UNKNOWN requiring a mandatory validation_plan_ref, mirrored against C1's existing nullable-column pattern.
AC-7 (C2 interface populated, concrete example): SATISFIED -- §6 populates step_kind/action_class/gate_reference/timeout_s/expect-result for the real RB.3b add-backup-local step, leaving the expect.regex value itself UNKNOWN (C6's job) rather than inventing vendor semantics.
AC-8 (>=10 testable AC for B1-4/B1-5/B1-6): SATISFIED -- §7 gives 12.
AC-9 (contradictions section, documents checked, no PO-reserved decision reopened): SATISFIED -- §8: no contradiction with frozen authority found; documents checked named explicitly (including a deliberate check of CAPABILITY_STATE_VOCABULARY_AND_PRESENTATION.md's D1-D7 resolver for a naming collision with this document's own "capability registry" -- none found once distinguished); two DRAFT-document amendments (design §6.3's sample and its transport assumption) are named as this document's own K-3/CP-D7 mandate, not a reopening of FROZEN authority; 4 open items recorded, none touching a PO-reserved decision.
AC-10 (no extraction performed, boundary stated): SATISFIED -- §1.2's table states the C4/C6 boundary explicitly; §6's worked example deliberately leaves the RB.3b step's expect-regex value UNKNOWN rather than asserting it; §8 item 4 defers the shared-fact freshness window to C6.
